## Insert or update payroll period data

<a id="opIdPatchPayrollPeriodDataByEmploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/payrollperioddata \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "costCenter": {
      "key": 2
    },
    "costUnit": {
      "key": 2
    },
    "distributionUnit": {
      "key": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
    },
    "payrollComponents": [
      {
        "isSupplement": false,
        "payrollComponent": {
          "key": 1
        },
        "value": 144
      }
    ],
    "payrollPeriod": {
      "periodNumber": 1,
      "year": 2017
    },
    "payslipText": "Additional payslip for bonus",
    "payslipType": {
      "key": 2
    },
    "shift": {
      "shiftNumber": 1
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/payrollperioddata`

**This endpoint is the REST alternative to the ImporteerGegevens (Variabele Gegevens) SOAP webservice functionality**  <br/> <br/> __Activity name :__ PatchPayrollPeriodDataByEmploymentId <br/> <br/>         This endpoint is typically used by applications that are considered to be leading in regard to the values for the payroll components they manage. For most (external) applications this will the most viable endpoint to achieve that functionality. Loket considers these parties as not interested in the current state of the payroll period data in the Loket.nl database. This endpoint is provided to make these scenarios easier to implement since no GET call is required to determine whether a POST or PUT call is to be performed to either insert or update payroll period data.
Based on the current state of the database Loket.nl will either insert a new record or update the existing record with the supplied data.
* A new record is created when the combination of `payrollPeriod`, `shift`, `payslipType`, `distributionUnit`, `costCenter` and `costUnit` is valid and _does not_ exist for the employment. Next to that, the objects consisting of `payrollComponent`, `value` and `attribute` are inserted into the database. <br />
* An update is performed when the combination of `payrollPeriod`, `shift`, `payslipType`, `distributionUnit`, `costCenter` and `costUnit` _does_ exist for the employment. In that case the specified objects consisting of `payrollComponent`, `value` and `attribute` are inserted into the database, overwriting existing values. Existing records with a `payrollComponent.key` that is not supplied in the request are not modified. <br/> <br/> __Metadata :__ <br/> Possible values for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the PATCH URL <br/> Possible values for fields of the type 'metadata' that are PERIOD-specific can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata/year/{year}/period/{periodNumber}` to the PATCH URL     <br/> <br/>   __Default values :__ <br/> Default values may be acquired by adding `/defaults` (GET) to the PATCH url . It is very much (!!!) recommended to acquire the defaults-objects first and use that information when inserting data for this employment. I.e. use the default values for costCenter, shift etcetera and the complement the object with the payroll components you want to provide. <br/> <br/>      __Extra background reading :__ <br/> It may be useful to read more about payroll period data (variabele gegevens, mutaties) on the Loket.nl [helpdesk portal](https://helpdesk.loket.nl/hc/nl/articles/115003667669-Variabele-mutaties-Individuele-vastlegging). Please note that this information is in Dutch and access is required. <br/>

<h1 id="loketnl-api-benefits-and-deductions">Benefits and deductions</h1>

NL: Toeslagen. Payroll component data for part of, one or multiple payroll period(s). If the same `payrollComponent.Key` is also present in the `payroll period data` for a payroll period then, depending on the configuration in `payroll period data` the two values will either be 1) added up; or 2) payroll period data will overwrite the BenefitsAndDeduction for the given payroll period. Only certain payroll components are usable as a Benefit and Deduction, the corresponding categories are listed in payrollComponent.category in this resource. <br/> <br/>Per payroll component a so called 'broken chain' business logic applies. This means that the records for that payroll component may NOT overlap each other, based on startDate and endDate of each record. Also, if an existing record in the chain is not closed and a subsequent record is created than Loket will automatically set the endDate for the already existing record.

<h1 id="loketnl-api-wage">Wage</h1>

NL: Beloning. Manage the wage of an employment <br/> <br/>For Wage records, so called 'linked chain' business logic applies. This means that the records for that payroll component may NOT overlap each other, based on startDate and endDate of each record, AND because it is a linked chain is not allowed to have 'gaps' between separate records. This also means that if an existing record in the chain is not closed and a subsequent record is created than Loket will automatically set the endDate for the already existing record (and vice versa when deleting a record).

`PUT /providers/employers/employees/employments/wages/{wageId}`

__Activity name :__ PutWageByWageId

Edit the details of a wage 

__Metadata :__ Possible options for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the PUT wage URL.

        
The possible options for `payGrade` are scoped by a `payScale`. To obtain the pay grades for a pay scale a metadata call has to be performed with the following format `../wages/metadata/payscale/{key}`. Where {key} is the key of the `payScale` (obtained via the first metadata call) for which the pay grades are to be returned.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "applyPayGrade": true,
  "employerCosts": 3500,
  "employerCostsType": {
    "key": 1
  },
  "grossWage": 2300,
  "grossWageType": {
    "key": 2
  },
  "netWage": 2400,
  "netWageType": {
    "key": 1
  },
  "payGrade": {

}

While a part-time wage does not. E.g. A full-time wage of 2400 euro’s is registered. The employments works 20 out of 40 hours (40 fours is a full-time shift) thus having a 20/40 = 50% part-time percentage. The part-time hours (deviatingHoursPerWeek) are accessible through the endpoint for working hours of an employement. ## Create an wage for an employment

<a id="opIdPostWageByEmploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/wages \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "applyPayGrade": true,
    "employerCosts": 3500,
    "employerCostsType": {
      "key": 1
    },
    "grossWage": 2300,
    "grossWageType": {
      "key": 2
    },
    "netWage": 2400,
    "netWageType": {
      "key": 1
    },
    "payGrade": {
      "key": 1
    },
    "payScale": {
      "key": 1
    },
    "startDate": "1995-05-21"
  }'
```

`POST /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/wages`

__Activity name :__ PostWageByEmploymentId

Create a new wage record for the given employment

__Metadata :__ Possible options for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the POST Wage URL.

        
The possible options for `payGrade` are scoped by a `payScale`. To obtain the pay grades for a pay scale a metadata call has to be performed with the following format `../wages/metadata/payscale/{key}`. Where {key} is the key of the `payScale` (obtained via the first metadata call) for which the pay grades are to be returned.

__Defaults :__ Default values for a new object can be acquired by adding `/defaults' to the POST URL and performing a GET action.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "applyPayGrade": true,
  "employerCosts": 3500,
  "employerCostsType": {
    "key": 1
  },
  "grossWage": 2300,
  "grossWageType": {
    "key": 2
  },
  "netWage": 2400,
  "netWageType": {
    "key": 1
  },
  "payGrade": {
    "key": 1
  },
  "payScale": {
    "key": 1
  },
  "startDate": "1995-05-21"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-wage-for-an-employment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|employmentId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the employment|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|body|body|object|true|Wage to add to the employment.|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-working-hours">Working hours</h1>

NL: Werktijd/ Arbeidstijd. Manage the working hours of an employment <br/> <br/>For WorkingHours records, so called 'linked chain' business logic applies. This means that the records for that payroll component may NOT overlap each other, based on startDate and endDate of each record, AND because it is a linked chain is not allowed to have 'gaps' between separate records. This also means that if an existing record in the chain is not closed and a subsequent record is created than Loket will automatically set the endDate for the already existing record (and vice versa when deleting a record).


## Details of the working hours

  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`PUT /providers/employers/employees/employments/workinghours/{workinghoursId}`

__Activity name :__  PutWorkingHoursByWorkingHoursId       <br/> <br/>  Create a new working hours record for an employment<br/>  Please note that so-called chain validation exists for working hours records. In other words, the time periods of records for an employment cannot overlap with each other.<br/> A new or changed startDate affects the endDate of its preceding record.<br/>  When PUT-ing a new record, the startDate must be greater then the preceding record's startDate.

__Metadata :__ Possible options for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the PUT URL.

`POST /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/workinghours`

__Activity name :__  PostWorkingHoursByEmploymentId <br/> <br/>  Create a new working hours record for an employment<br/>  Please note that so-called chain validation exists for working hours records. In other words, the time periods of records for an employment cannot overlap with each other.<br/> A new or changed startDate affects the endDate of its preceding record.<br/>  When POST-ing a new record, the startDate must be greater then the preceding record's startDate.

__Metadata :__ Possible options for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the POST URL.

__Defaults :__ Default values for a new object can be acquired by adding `/defaults' to the POST URL.

<h1 id="loketnl-api-payslip">Payslip</h1>

NL: Loonstroken/loonresultaten werknemer. Download the payslip(s) for an employment

## Get payroll period results of an employment for a year

<a id="opIdGetPayrollPeriodResultsByEmploymentIdAndYear"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/payrollperiodresults/year/2018 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/payrollperiodresults/year/{year}`

__Activity name :__ GetPayrollPeriodResultsByEmploymentIdAndYear

Download the payroll results (conform overzicht strook) of an employment per payroll period for the provided year.

**Please note the following:**  There is a major functional difference between acquiring the payslips per payroll run or acquiring payroll results per payroll period(in this case a year). In Loket, for each (approved) run there will be payroll results for that run. Each employment with any results in that payroll run will have (one or more) payslips, these are the payroll results/ payslips for that run. Often these results relate to the payroll period for which that payroll run is performed, but the results may apply to other payroll periods. __For example:__ the payroll run for March may contain results that apply to the months January and/or February. (this may occur within a specific year)

* Requesting payslips/results per RUN will provide you all payroll results from that specific payrollrun regardless of the period it applies to.
* Requesting PERIOD results will provide you all (approved) payroll results for that period regardless of the payroll run it comes from.

De facto the payslips/results per RUN are your actual payslips (loonstrook). The results per period are more useful as an overview per period (overzichtstrook).

One more remark: the response of this endpoint is dependent on the role of the user. If the user has role 'werknemer' than the results shown are only based on those approved payroll runs where the ESS-date is on or before today. For other users the results will contain data from all approved payroll runs regardless of ESS-date.

|---|---|---|---|---|

|employmentId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the employment|
|year|path|integer(int32)|true|The payroll year|

## List of payslips for an employment

<a id="opIdGetPayslipsByEmploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/payslips \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/payslips`

__Activity name :__ GetPayslipsByEmploymentId

Get a list of payslips for the specified employment, including the GUID of the corresponding payroll run.

The function of this endpoint is dependent on the role of the user;
* For users with the role of 'werknemer';  The endpoint only returns results for payrollruns that have the status 'approved' AND for which results of the payroll are available for ESS (based on the ESS-date of the payrollrun) .
* For users with any other role (in most cases); the endpoin returns results for approved payrollruns irregardless of the ESS date.

|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|

|filter|query|string|false|Filter the collection|

## Download a cummulative payslip for a single payroll period

<a id="opIdGetPayrollPeriodSummaryByEmploymentIdAndPayrollPeriodId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/payslips/summary/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/payslips/summary/{payrollPeriodId}`

__Activity name :__ GetPayrollPeriodSummaryByEmploymentIdAndPayrollPeriodId

Download a cummulative payslip for a single payroll period in a single PDF.

e.g. If the employment has to payslips for a single period this endpoint will return one (summary)payslip that is the cummaltion of both the payslips.

__Metadata :__ Possible options for `payrollPeriodId` can be acquired (GET) the following URL /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/payslips/summary/metadata.
Please note that the returned payroll periods are dependend on the year filter setting for the employer. The options are, return payroll periodes for:
 
* current payroll year * current and previous payroll year * all payroll years

|payrollPeriodId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of an payroll period|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-payment-information">Payment information</h1>

NL: Excasso (i.e. SEPA, IBAN). Manage the payment information. To what (SEPA country) IBAN is the wage/salary to be payed to. NOTEL by far the largest part of outgoing payments will be based on the information in these SEPA payment information records (i.e. this resource). Other resources may contain further payment specifics.

## Get the details of a payment information sepa

<a id="opIdGetPaymentInformationSepaBypaymentInformationSepaId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/paymentinformationsepa/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/employees/employments/paymentinformationsepa/{paymentInformationSepaId}`

__Activity name :__ GetPaymentInformationSepaBypaymentInformationSepaId

Get the detail of a payment information SEPA record.
 
For a specific payroll component, the record indicates to which IBAN account number it should be related for the purpose of outgoing payments.  This includes, but is not limited to, the payment of wages for an employment. For each payroll component there can only be one outgoing payment record per employment.

`PUT /providers/employers/employees/employments/paymentinformationsepa/{paymentInformationSepaId}`

__Activity name :__ PutPaymentInformationSepaByPaymentInformationSepaId

Edit an existing SEPA payment-record (for an employment).
For each unique payroll component there can only be one payment record per employment.
Possible values for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the URL


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "bic": "AUDFDE21",
  "cityBeneficiary": "Rome",
  "description1": "xx",
  "description2": "x",
  "iban": "NL52ABNA0424968264",
  "nameBeneficiary": "Ben Hur",
  "payrollComponent": {
    "key": 260
  },
  "visibleOnPayslip": true
}

## Get a list of payment information sepa

<a id="opIdGetPaymentInformationSepaByEmploymentId"></a>

```

`GET /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/paymentinformationsepa`

__Activity name :__ GetPaymentInformationSepaByEmploymentId

Get a list of payment information for SEPA bank accounts (IBAN's) for an employment.
 
For a specific payroll component, the record indicates to which IBAN payments will be made. 
This includes, but is not limited to, the payment of wages for an employment.
 
For each payroll component there can only be one payment information record per employment.

|employmentId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the employment|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|filter|query|string|false|Filter the collection|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Order the collection on one or more fields|
|pageNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies which page should be returned|
|pageSize|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies the number of objects per page|

## create a new payment information sepa record

<a id="opIdPostPaymentInformationSepaByEmploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/paymentinformationsepa \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: applicationjson;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{"bic":"AUDFDE21","cityBeneficiary":"Rome","description1":"xx","description2":"x","iban":"NL52ABNA0424968264","nameBeneficiary":"Ben Hur","payrollComponent":{"key":260},"visibleOnPayslip":true}'
```

`POST /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/paymentinformationsepa`

__Activity name :__ PostPaymentInformationSepaByEmploymentId

Create a new Payment information SEPA record for an employment.<br/> For each unique payroll component there can only be one payment record per employment.

__Metadata :__ Possible values for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the URL

__Defaults :__ Default values for a new object can be acquired by adding `/defaults' to the POST URL.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "bic": "AUDFDE21",
  "cityBeneficiary": "Rome",
  "description1": "xx",
  "description2": "x",
  "iban": "NL52ABNA0424968264",
  "nameBeneficiary": "Ben Hur",
  "payrollComponent": {
    "key": 260
  },
  "visibleOnPayslip": true
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-payment-information-sepa-record-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|employmentId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the employment|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|body|body|object|true|Payment information sepa record to add to the employment|
|» bic|body|string \| null|false|BIC /SWIFT code. Only applicable for a non-Dutch IBAN<br>|
|» cityBeneficiary|body|string \| null|false|City name of beneficiary.<br>|
|» description1|body|string \| null|false|Description 1. Both description field values will be a line in the (unstructured) description of the SEPA file.<br>|
|» description2|body|string \| null|false|Description 2. Both description field values will be a line in the (unstructured) description of the SEPA file.<br>|
|» iban|body|string|false|International Bank Account Number (IBAN). Only IBAN without spaces are accepted.<br>|
|» nameBeneficiary|body|string \| null|false|Name of beneficiary.<br>|
|» payrollComponent|body|object(metaData)|false|The payroll component for which the outgoing payment records applies.<br><br>`payrollComponent` is a metadata field within the payroll administration context. Possible values can be managed by the user.<br>|
|» » key|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» visibleOnPayslip|body|boolean|false|Indicates whether the payment-component is visible on a payslip.<br>|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-payment-information-separate-payments">Payment information separate payments</h1>

NL: Excasso afgesplitst van netto. This entity indicates, if applicable, the bank account(s) (i.e. IBAN's) where a given amount of the net salary for this employment will be paid to.
 

Normally, the IBAN for the payment of net wage will be set by the PaymentInformation(SEPA) record. However, this entity allows to take a part of the net salary (a fixed amount) and set this to a different IBAN (for that part of the payment). For example, when a person wants to have part of his earnings to his regular banking account and part of his earnings to his savings account.


## Get the details of a payment information SEPA separate payment record

<a id="opIdGetPaymentInformationSepaSeparatePaymentByPaymentInformationSepaSeparatePaymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/paymentinformationsepaseparatepayments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/employees/employments/paymentinformationsepaseparatepayments/{paymentInformationSepaSeparatePaymentId}`

__Activity name :__ GetPaymentInformationSepaSeparatePaymentByPaymentInformationSepaSeparatePaymentId

Get the detail of a payment information SEPA record. For a specific payroll component, the record indicates to which IBAN account number it should be related for the purpose of outgoing payments.  This includes, but is not limited to, the payment of wages for an employment.  For each payroll component there can only be one outgoing payment record per employment.


<h3 id="get-the-details-of-a-payment-information-sepa-separate-payment-record-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|paymentInformationSepaSeparatePaymentId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the SEPA payment record|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-payment-information-non-sepa">Payment information non-SEPA</h1>

NL: Excasso Buitenland. Manage the payment information for non-SEPA payments. Mostly useful for performing foreign payments in case no SEPA/IBAN information is available.

## Get the details of a payment information non-SEPA

<a id="opIdGetPaymentInformationNonSepaBypaymentInformationNonSepaId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/paymentinformationnonsepa/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/employees/employments/paymentinformationnonsepa/{paymentInformationNonSepaId}`

__Activity name :__ GetPaymentInformationNonSepaByPaymentInformationNonSepaId

Get the detail of a payment information non-SEPA record.
For a specific payroll component, the record indicates to which IBAN account number it should be related for the purpose of outgoing payments. 
This includes, but is not limited to, the payment of wages for an employment.
For each payroll component there can only be one outgoing payment record per employment.

|---|---|---|---|---|
|paymentInformationNonSepaId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the SEPA payment record|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|

## Get a list of payment information non-SEPA

<a id="opIdGetPaymentInformationNonSepaByEmploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/paymentinformationnonsepa \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/paymentinformationnonsepa`

__Activity name :__ GetPaymentInformationNonSepaByEmploymentId

Get a list of payment information for non-SEPA bank accounts for an employment. These are payments to be performed that will NOT be based on an IBAN (which is the standard), so this is mostly useful for foreign payments that are not based within a SEPA-country. 

For a specific payroll component, the record indicates to which account payments will be made.  This includes, but is not limited to, the payment of wages for an employment.

For each payroll component there can only be one payment Information record per employment.


<h3 id="get-a-list-of-payment-information-non-sepa-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|employmentId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the employment|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|filter|query|string|false|Filter the collection|

## Create a new payment information non-SEPA record

<a id="opIdPostPaymentInformationNonSepaByEmploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/paymentinformationnonsepa \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: applicationjson;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{"bank":{"address":"Via Roma 3","bankIdentifierCode":"AUDFDE21","city":"Rome","country":{"key":1},"name":"Ben Hur"},"bankAccountNumber":"0403830171874018","beneficiary":{"address":"Via Roma 3","city":"Rome","country":{"key":1},"name":"Ben Hur"},"payrollComponent":{"key":260}}'
```

`POST /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/paymentinformationnonsepa`

__Activity name :__ PostPaymentInformationNonSepaByEmploymentId

Create a new payment information non-SEPA record for an employment. For each unique payroll component there can only be one payment information non-SEPA record per employment.

__Metadata :__ Possible values for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the URL

__Defaults :__ Default values for a new object can be acquired by adding `/defaults' to the POST URL.

<h1 id="loketnl-api-fiscal-company-car">Fiscal company car</h1>

NL: Werknemer auto fiscaal. Registration of company car for fiscal (tax-related) purposes

## Details of a fiscal company car record

<a id="opIdGetFiscalCompanyCarByFiscalCompanyCarId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/fiscalcompanycars/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/employees/employments/fiscalcompanycars/{fiscalCompanyCarId}`

__Activity name:__ GetFiscalCompanyCarByFiscalCompanyCarId


 Get the details of fiscal company car 


 Please note this resource is related for the registration of the company car for tax purposes.
 This is NOT directly related to the registration of the company car(s) related to the HRM-module Verstrekking

`POST /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/fiscalcompanycars`

__Activity name:__ PostFiscalCompanyCarByEmploymentId
    

Create a fiscal company cars record for an employment.

Please note this resource is related for the registration of the company car for tax purposes and will be included in the salary calculations.  This is NOT directly related to the registration of the company car(s) related to the HRM-module Verstrekking

  "licensePlateNumber": "GP586D",
  "reasonForNoAdditionalTaxLiability": {
    "key": 1
  },
  "startDate": "2021-01-01",
  "taxableBenefitForPrivateUse": 2000,
  "valueForTaxPurposes": 20000
}

__Metadata :__ Possible options for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the POST URL.

<h1 id="loketnl-api-chamber-of-commerce">Chamber of commerce</h1>

NL: Het opvragen van basis bedrijfsinformatie bij de kamer van koophandel.

## Acquire company information

<a id="opIdGetCompanyInformationByChamberOfCommerceNumber"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/chamberofcommerce/string/companyinformation \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /chamberofcommerce/{chamberOfCommerceNumber}/companyinformation`

__Activity name:__ GetCompanyInformationByChamberOfCommerceNumber

This endpoint allows the user to acquire basic company information for a specific chamber of commerce number.


<h3 id="acquire-company-information-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|chamberOfCommerceNumber|path|string|true|The unique identifier of the kvk (8 numbers)|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-employment-funds">Employment funds</h1>

## Details of an employment fund

In doing so the actual calculation for the `fund` will no longer take place as the outcome is fixed. This has the side effect that the "grondslag" is no longer calculated. `POST /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/abpfunds`

__Activity name :__ PostAbpFundByEmploymentId

__Metadata :__ Possible options for fields of the type "metadata" can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the POST URL.

__Defaults :__ Default values for a new object can be acquired by adding `/defaults" to the POST URL.

Activate an abp fund for an employment

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "deviations": null,
  "endDate": "2018-10-23",
  "fixedContribution": null,
  "fund": {
    "key": 1
  },
  "startDate": "2018-01-01"
}
```

<h3 id="activate-an-abp-fund-for-an-employment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|employmentId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the employment|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|body|body|object|true|Add an abp fund for an employment.|
|» deviations|body|object \| null|false|Only set a value for the underlying fields if you want to deviate from the values as defined by the selected `fund`.<br><br>Deviating is done on either all the fields or none.<br><br>__Note:__ `deviations` and `fixedContribution` are mutually exclusive.|
|» » employmentContributionPercentage|body|number(double)|false|Deviating employment contribution percentage. This value will overrule the value of the selected `fund`. Indicates percentage wise how much the employment has to contribute to the payment of the "fund" contribution.<br><br>__Note:__ Records with a `startDate` before 1-1-2014 have a different regular expression__:__ ^(\d{1,3})(\.\d{1,3})?$ (a scale of 3 instead of 4).|
|» » totalContributionPercentage|body|number(double)|false|Deviating total contribution percentage. This value will overrule the value of the selected `fund`. The difference between `employmentContributionPercentage` and `totalContributionPercentage` will be paid by the employer.<br><br>__Note:__ Records with a `startDate` before 1-1-2014 have a different regular expression__:__ ^(\d{1,3})(\.\d{1,3})?$ (a scale of 3 instead of 4).|
|» endDate|body|string(date) \| null|false|The end date of the entity. The date is up to and including.|
|» fixedContribution|body|object \| null|false|With the underlying elements fixed values (money) can be set as the result of the Fund calculation.  In doing so the actual calculation for the `fund` will no longer take place as the outcome is fixed. This has the side effect that the "grondslag" is no longer calculated.  In the data exchange with certain parties the "grondslag" has to be communicated allongside the contribution.  In those cases do not use this option as the calculation is disabled.<br><br>Setting a fixed contribution is done on either all the fields or none.<br><br>__Note:__ `deviations` and `fixedContribution` are mutually exclusive.|
|» » employmentContribution|body|number(double)|false|The employment contribution (in money) that the employee will pay instead of what the calculation of the `fund` indicates.<br><br>__Note:__ Records with a `startDate` before 1-1-2014 have a different range, from 0.00 up to 9999.99|
|» » totalContribution|body|number(double)|false|The total contribution (in money) that the employer and employee pay instead of what the calculation of the `fund` indicates.<br><br>__Note:__ Records with a `startDate` before 1-1-2014 have a different range, from 0 up to 9999.99|
|» fund|body|object(metadata)|false|none|
|» » key|body|integer(int32)|false|The key for the fund<br>|
|» startDate|body|string(date)|false|The date on which this fund starts.<br><br>A (linked chain)[./#section/Data/Date-chains] per fund is maintained within this resource. So multiple funds can be active at the same time but one specific fund can never be active multiple times at the same time.|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-protected-earnings">Protected earnings</h1>

NL: Beslagvrije voet. The protected earnings rate is agreed between the Court and the Employee and so will vary from order to order – it is not a predetermined amount. The Employees net take-home pay cannot be reduced by a attachment of earnings so that it is lower than this amount.

<h1 id="loketnl-api-deviating-awf-contribution">Deviating AWF Contribution</h1>

NL: Afwijkende AWF-premie. From 2020 it is possible that in exceptional cases a deviating AWF contribution (afwijkende AWF premie) has to be applied for an employment. If no exception is applicable please do not use this entity, in that case the payroll process will determine the applicable type of AWF contribution.

`POST /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/transitioncompensation/calculate`

This is a controller endpoint to perform a calculation. No actual data will be stored as a result of these actions.

__Activity name :__ PostCalculateTransitionCompensationByEmploymentId

__Defaults :__ Default values for a new object can be acquired by adding `/defaults` to the POST URL. This will only include the default values for the input parameter fields (the actual calculation of the transition compensation is not part of that)

A calculation help for determining the transition compensation amount. (rekenhulp transitievergoeding)

The employments works 20 out of 40 hours (40 fours is a full-time shift) thus having a 20/40 = 50% part-time percentage. The part-time hours (deviatingHoursPerWeek) are accessible through the endpoint for working hours of an employement. When the key fields of these three wage types have a value 1 (meaning periodic wage), the payrollPeriodType field shows the period type (month, 4 weeks or week) applicable to the wages for the employment. <h1 id="loketnl-api-qwoater">Qwoater</h1>

Functionality to enable the Qwoater -> Loket integration

## List of employers using Qwoater

<a id="opIdGetQwoaterEmployersByUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/qwoater/employers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /qwoater/employers`

__Activity name :__ GetQwoaterEmployersByUser

Returns a list of employerIds that have at least one Qwoater product enabled with the corresponding providerId and lastModifiedVersionNumber for the employer.

**What does the 'last modified' version number reflect**

The sequence number of an employer is a sequential number that reflects whether any changes have occurred in any of its UNDERLYING employments.

More precisely, it reflects the sequence number after the latest change of any database record that relates to an employment within this employer.   What we consider to be 'underlying' employment data is based on a predefined set of tables, and of course given id.  This predefined set of tables can be found [here](../TablesLastModifiedVersionNumber.xlsx)

The scope of this predefined set is to represent 'static' employment data (vaste gegevens), and thus excludes payroll period data (variabele gegevens).

**When to use**

This endpoint is most useful for integrations that regularly synchronize Loket employment data with another system.  As there are no webhooks available, in practice these integrations would need to regularly poll all data to see whether there any changes in the employment data.  The most elementary approach of getting all employment data every time you sync acquires a LOT of calls, in some cases even millions per day.  Even though we can handle quite a lot, this is not always the desired way for both client and server. Hence, this endpoint enables an alternative solution to set up such an integration.

**How to use**

With every update (including additions and deletions) the version number will increase. I.e. the version number will NEVER decrease over time.  (Please note this is not only true within the context of a single employer (or any other entity) but applies to all changes in the database).
Consequently, in practice one would use this endpoint to check if any empLoyer version numbers have increased by applying the filter query parameter to the version field, for example `?filter=lastModifiedVersionNumber gt 70429274`.

*Recommended usage*

* Perform your regular synchronization of static employment data
* Store the highest version number, for which you have now processed all changes. (You may use the following parameter to do this `?orderBy=-lastModifiedVersionNumber` )
* Next time you want to perform synchronization. Call this endpoint with parameter `?filter=lastModifiedVersionNumber gt {{YourVersionNumber}}`
* Only get employment information for employers that are included in that filtered list. (exclude all other employers as you already know there have been no changes since the last synchronization)

`GET /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/{payrollAdministrationId}/payrollperiods/compare`

## Get payroll results for the given payroll period

<a id="opIdGetPayrollPeriodResultsByPayrollAdministrationIdAndPayrollPeriodId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/payrollperiods/0/payrollresults \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/{payrollAdministrationId}/payrollperiods/{payrollPeriodId}/payrollresults`

__Activity name :__ GetPayrollPeriodResultsByPayrollAdministrationIdAndPayrollPeriodId  
  

Returns the payroll results for the payroll period.

__Note :__ This endpoint is related to the `GetPayrollRunResultsByPayrollRunId` endpoint.
Both endpoints return the same output just in a different way. This endpoint returns the current state of the payroll results for the given period where as `GetPayrollRunResultsByPayrollRunId` returns the payroll results for the given payroll run (a payroll run can contain payroll results for multiple payroll periods). It's posible for payroll results to be created after the end of the payroll period it zelf. For example, the payroll periode 01-2020 ends at 31-01-2020 (in case of a monthly payroll period) it is posible that the payroll run for period 07-2020 contains payroll results for the period 01-2020 due to a retroactivity change for that period. This change in the payroll run for payroll period 07-2020 would require the system to reaquire the results for period 01-2020 (as they changed).


<h3 id="get-payroll-results-for-the-given-payroll-period-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|payrollAdministrationId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of an administration|
|payrollPeriodId|path|integer(int32)|true|The unique identifier of the payroll period|
|payrollComponents|query|[integer(int32)]|false|Can be used to filter what payroll components are returned. Cannot be used in combination with payrollComponentSet.|
|payrollComponentSet|query|string(uuid)|false|A predifined set of payroll components to filter what payroll components are returned|

## Download a SEPA file

<a id="opIdGetSepaFileBySepaFileId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrollruns/sepafiles/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08?requestedExecutionDate=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrollruns/sepafiles/{sepafileId}`

__Activity name :__ GetSepaFileBySepaFileId

Returns the specified SEPA payments file as a XML file.

<h3 id="download-a-sepa-file-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|sepafileId|path|string(uuid)|true|Sepa file ID|
|paymentType|query|string|false|Indicates the type of payment for the SEPA file.<br>In case salary is selected the following will be included in the SEPA xml file<br>```<br>  <CtgyPurp><br>    <Cd>SALA</Cd><br>  </CtgyPurp><br>```|
|batchBooking|query|string|false|Determines whether the Batch Booking \<BtchBookg\> tag is included in the SEPA file and if it is which value it is set to.  By defualt this value is set to Exclude.<br><br>Possible values for this parameter are:<br>- Exclude: Do not include \<BtchBookg\> tag in SEPA file<br>- IncludeTrue: Include \<BtchBookg\> tag in SEPA file and set it to 'True'<br>- IncludeFalse: Include \<BtchBookg\> tag in SEPA file and set it to 'False'<br>|
|requestedExecutionDate|query|string(date)|true|This value is used when creating the sepa file to set the value of \<ReqdExctnDt\>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|paymentType|Other|
|paymentType|Salary|
|batchBooking|BtchBookgExclude|
|batchBooking|BtchBookgTrue|
|batchBooking|BtchBookgFalse|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "version": {
    "obsoleteDate": "1970-01-01",
    "resourceVersion": "2018-12-31"
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": 12,
      "description": "Invalid value for <field>",

      "properties": [
        "string"
      ],
      "type": "BrokenBusinessRule"
    }
  ],
  "content": {}
}
```

}
```

## Get payroll run balance sheet

<a id="opIdGetPayrollRunBalanceSheetByPayrollRunId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrollruns/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/BalanceSheet \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrollruns/{payrollrunId}/BalanceSheet`

__Activity name :__ GetPayrollRunBalanceSheetByPayrollRunId

This endpoint returns per payroll components, marked as relevant for the general ledge (balance sheet), the sum of the values.

If for the given payroll period of the payroll run a "journal profile" is configured the endpoint also returns the ledger account and costcenter/costunit linked to the given payroll component in the "journal profile"


<h3 id="get-payroll-run-balance-sheet-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|payrollrunId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the payroll run|

## Download a total SEPA file

<a id="opIdGetTotalSepaFileByPayrollRunId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrollruns/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/totalsepafile?requestedExecutionDate=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrollruns/{payrollrunId}/totalsepafile`

__Activity name :__ GetTotalSepaFileByPayrollRunId

Returns the total SEPA payments file as a XML file. This file contains the payments of all the available SEPA payment files available for the specified payroll run.

<h3 id="download-a-total-sepa-file-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payrollrunId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the payroll run|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|paymentType|query|string|false|Indicates the type of payment for the SEPA file.<br>In case salary is selected the following will be included in the SEPA xml file<br>```<br>  <CtgyPurp><br>    <Cd>SALA</Cd><br>  </CtgyPurp><br>```|
|batchBooking|query|string|false|Determines whether the Batch Booking \<BtchBookg\> tag is included in the SEPA file and if it is which value it is set to.  By defualt this value is set to Exclude.<br><br>Possible values for this parameter are:<br>- Exclude: Do not include \<BtchBookg\> tag in SEPA file<br>- IncludeTrue: Include \<BtchBookg\> tag in SEPA file and set it to 'True'<br>- IncludeFalse: Include \<BtchBookg\> tag in SEPA file and set it to 'False'<br>|
|requestedExecutionDate|query|string(date)|true|This value is used when creating the sepa file to set the value of \<ReqdExctnDt\>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|paymentType|Other|
|paymentType|Salary|
|batchBooking|BtchBookgExclude|
|batchBooking|BtchBookgTrue|
|batchBooking|BtchBookgFalse|

## Download the provider logo

<a id="opIdGetProviderLogo"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/logo \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/{providerId}/logo`

__Activity name :__ GetProviderLogo

This activity is listed twice in the documentation due to the specified version caching path parameter. Including or exluding this parameter results in slightly different behaviour.

__Caching:__ This resource changes very infrequently and can be cached for a longer time.

Get the logo of the provider of the user. In case no logo is know the service will return a 404.

<h3 id="download-the-provider-logo-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

`GET /providers/{providerId}/logo/{version}`

__Activity name :__ GetProviderLogo

This activity is listed twice in the documentation due to the specified version caching path parameter. Including or exluding this parameter results in slightly different behaviour.

__Caching:__ This resource changes very infrequently and can be cached for a longer time.

|version|path|string(uuid)|true|An guid generated for caching. The value does not influence the output of this function. The provider/logo endpoint returns the URI of the current logo with the version.|

## Change the status of a journal run

<a id="opIdPatchJournalRunByJournalRunId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/journalruns/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "action": "MarkAsProcessed",
    "application": {
      "key": 2
    },
    "message": "string"
  }'
```

`PATCH /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/journalruns/{journalrunId}`

__Activity name :__ PatchJournalRunByJournalRunId

Update the status of a journal run
* Action 'markAsSuccessfullyExported'; will change the status of the journal run to 'exported'. Please note this action will not perform an actual export, but simply allows the user the manage status to match their actualities.</br>
* Action 'MarkAsProcessingFailed'; will change the status of the journal run to 'export failed'. Please note this action will not perform an actual export, but simply allows the user the manage status to match their actualities.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "MarkAsProcessed",
  "application": {
    "key": 2
  },
  "message": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="change-the-status-of-a-journal-run-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|journalrunId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the payroll run|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|body|body|object|true|Change the status of a journal run|
|» action|body|string|false|The action to perform on the journal run<br>* MarkAsProcessed  --> (from the loket.nl point of view) Indicates that the client succesfully processed the data (indicating that the results were imported in the financial application).<br>* MarkAsProcessingFailed --> (from the loket.nl point of view) Indicates that the client was unable to process the results. Use the `message` field to communicate the error(s).|
|» application|body|object(metadata)|false|The application that downloaded and processed the results|
|» » key|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» message|body|string \| null|false|Message to be displayed to the loket.nl user|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» action|MarkAsProcessed|
|» action|MarkAsProcessingFailed|

`POST /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/journalruns/{journalrunId}/send`

__Activity name :__ PostSendJournalRunExportByJournalRunId

Send a journal run to a journal application. Use the defaults and metadata to acquire the journal application settings. The defaults endpoint contains values for all required fields. 

There are two metadata endpoints: 

- /journalruns/{journalrunId}/send/metadata

- /journalruns/{journalrunId}/send/metadata/accountId/{accountId}

## Initiate journal run (journaliseren)

<a id="opIdPostInitiateJournalRunByPayrollAdministrationId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/journalruns/initiate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/{payrollAdministrationId}/journalruns/initiate`

__Activity name :__ PostInitiateJournalRunByPayrollAdministrationId This is a controller endpoint to perform an action.

In the older Loket GUI this specific action is referred to as 'journaliseren' If this action is performed succesfully the journal run will be created with status 0 and will be queud for processing. After the initiated run has been picked up and processed by the background process, then the status of the run will be changed accordingly.

This action may be performed for all payroll periods that are *available for the payroll administration* AND that meet one of the following requirements;
* The payroll period is less then 7 years in the past
* There is a journal profile configured for the given payroll period
* There is an approved payroll run for the given payroll period that has no other journalruns except for failed or removed journalruns
* All the payroll runs are processed in order so in order to start a journalrun the previous payrollrun (that should have a journalrun) has to have a succesfull journal run in order to start the next one

__Metadata :__  No metadata endpoint available for this controller endpoint.

__Defaults :__ Defaults endpoint is available for this controller endpoint by adding /defaults. Also, an endpoint is available to retrieve initiation values for a specific period.

<h3 id="initiate-journal-run-journaliseren-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payrollAdministrationId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of an administration|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|

`PUT /providers/employers/employees/employments/journalallocations/{journalAllocationId}`

__Activity name:__ PutJournalAllocationByJournalAllocationId

Edit the details of a financial journal allocation record (journaliseren module)

* Possible options for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the PUT URL.
* Possible options dependent on a specific `startPeriod` can be acquired via `/metadata/year/{year}/period/{period}`

  }
}

<h1 id="loketnl-api-payroll-period-data-on-administration-level">Payroll period data on administration level</h1>

NL: Browser variabele gegevens. Payroll period data on administration level. (Get periods via payroll periods within the payroll category)

## List of payroll period data on payroll administration level

<a id="opIdGetPayrollPeriodDataByPayrollAdministrationIdAndPayrollPeriodId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/payrollPeriods/0/payrollperioddata?payslipType=0' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/{payrollAdministrationId}/payrollPeriods/{payrollPeriodId}/payrollperioddata`

__Activity name :__ GetPayrollPeriodDataByPayrollAdministrationIdAndPayrollPeriodId

Get a list of all payroll period data for all the active employment in the given payroll period for the give payroll administration. Payroll period data relates to a single payroll period.

This endpoint only returns objects for which the employment meets the filter settings set at the user level. Note that filter settings are set for a user <-> employer <-> client combination.

__Metadata :__  Possible options for the query string parameters can be acquired (GET) via the `/metadata` endpoint.  The URI for this endpoint is `../providers/employers/payrolladministrations/{payrollAdministrationId}/payrollPeriods/payrollperioddata/metadata`.

__Defaults :__ Default values for the query string parameters can be acquired via the `/defaults` endpoint.  The URI for this endpoint is `../providers/employers/payrolladministrations/{payrollAdministrationId}/payrollPeriods/payrollperioddata/defaults`.


<h3 id="list-of-payroll-period-data-on-payroll-administration-level-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payrollAdministrationId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of an administration|
|payrollPeriodId|path|integer(int32)|true|The unique identifier of the payroll period|
|payslipType|query|integer(int32)|true|Controles which payroll period data is returned either for the normal payslip of the tarif payslip.|
|payrollComponentSet|query|string(uuid)|false|A predefined set of payroll components to filter which payroll components are returned.<br><br>__Note:__ Either `payrollComponentSet` or `payrollComponentCategory` must have a value.<br><br>Mutually exclusive with `payrollComponentCategory`.|
|payrollComponentCategory|query|integer(int32)|false|A predefined category of payroll components to filter which payroll components are returned.<br><br>__Note:__ Either `payrollComponentSet` or `payrollComponentCategory` must have a value.<br><br>Mutually exclusive with `payrollComponentSet`.|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|filter|query|string|false|Filter the collection|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Order the collection on one or more fields|
|pageNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies which page should be returned|
|pageSize|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies the number of objects per page|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-payroll-tax-return">Payroll tax return</h1>

NL: Loonaangifte. Manage the payroll tax returns

## Change the status of payroll tax returns

<a id="opIdPatchPayrollTaxReturnsByPayrollTaxReturnIds"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrolltaxreturns \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    {
      "action": "confirm",
      "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
    }
  ]'
```

`PATCH /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrolltaxreturns`

__Activity name :__ PatchPayrollTaxReturnsByPayrollTaxReturnIds

This endpoints changes the status of the list of the payroll tax returns provided in the request body based on the provided action.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "action": "confirm",
    "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="change-the-status-of-payroll-tax-returns-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|body|body|[object]|true|The request body contains an array of objects containing a `PayrolTaxReturnId` and a `taxReturnMessageStatus`<br>|
|» action|body|string|true|The action to perform on the payroll tax return|
|» id|body|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of an object (GUID/UUID)|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» action|confirm|
|» action|cancel|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-payroll-tax-return-response-message">Payroll tax return response message</h1>

NL: Loonaangifte response message. Payroll tax return response message

## Send the response message for the payroll tax return

<a id="opIdPostSendResponseMessageByPayrollTaxReturnId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrolltaxreturns/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/sendresponsemessage \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "responseMessageFile": ""
  }'
```

`POST /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrolltaxreturns/{payrolltaxreturnId}/sendresponsemessage`

__Activity name :__ PostSendResponseMessageByPayrollTaxReturnId

Send the response message of the payroll tax return (loonaangifte) that was received from the Belastingdienst,  to Loket.nl . 
This is ONLY applicable for the limited group of parties that send and receive the payroll tax return themselves to the Belastingdienst. For the purposes of having those results visible in Loket the corresponding response message can be send to Loket via this endpoint.

What this endpoint does is the following:
* It will receive the xml response message. For the schema (XSD) of this xml response message we refer to the documentation by the Belastingdienst itself
* A set of input validations will be performed.
* If those steps are succesful the xml response message will placed in a designated directory. Where it will be picked up for final processing by a proces that runs about every 15 minutes
* In other words; the result of this action will NOT be immediately visible


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "responseMessageFile": ""
}
```

<h3 id="send-the-response-message-for-the-payroll-tax-return-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payrolltaxreturnId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the payroll tax return|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|body|body|object|true|The request body contains the xml response message|
|» responseMessageFile|body|string|false|base64 encoded xml file of the response message|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "version": {
    "obsoleteDate": "1970-01-01",
    "resourceVersion": "2018-12-31"
  },
  "messages": [

      "code": 12,
      "description": "Invalid value for <field>",

      "properties": [
        "string"
      ],
      "type": "BrokenBusinessRule"
    }
  ],
  "content": {}
}
```

  "message": "Authorization has been denied for this request."

<h1 id="loketnl-api-payroll-tax-return-by-message-reference">Payroll tax return by message reference</h1>

NL: Loonaangifte obv berichtkenmerk. For some external parties it is more practical to perform these actions based on the messageReference as identifier.

## Change the status of payroll tax returns

<a id="opIdPatchPayrollTaxReturnByMessageReference"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrolltaxreturns/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "action": "confirm"
  }'
```

`PATCH /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrolltaxreturns/{messageReference}`

__Activity name :__ PatchPayrollTaxReturnByMessageReference

This endpoints changes the status of the payroll tax returns provided in the path parameters based on the provided action.

Functionally, this endpoint is very similar to PatchPayrollTaxReturnsByPayrollTaxReturnIds endpoint,  however this endpoint takes the messageReference (NL: BERICHTKENMERK) as path id. Instead of payrollTaxReturnId (GUID). AND, in contrast, this endpoint is a SINGLE PATCH endpoint which consumes a path id.  


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "confirm"
}
```

## Acquire the address for a combination of `postalCode` and `houseNumber`

<a id="opIdGetAddressByPostalCodeAndHouseNumber"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/locationservices/address?postalCode=5037AA&houseNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /locationservices/address`

__Activity name :__  GetAddressyByPostalCodeAndHouseNumber <br/> Acquire the address for a combination of `postalCode` and `houseNumber`.  Only Dutch addresses are supported. Both the postalCode and houseNumber have to be specified as query parameters to perform a succesful call to this endpoint. The city and street name returned by this endpoint are according to the nen standard     <br/>

|postalCode|query|string|true|A valid postal code|
|houseNumber|query|integer|true|A valid house number (without addition)|

## Employment templates

<a id="opIdGetEmploymentTemplatesByEmployerId"></a>

> Code samples

curl https://example.com/providers/employers/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/employmenttemplates \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/{employerId}/employmenttemplates`

__Activity name :__ GetEmploymentTemplatesByEmployerId
Get the employment templates that are available at this employer's level. 

An employment templates (werknemersjabloon) provides as predefined set of values for a new employment.  This is mostly when creating a new employee or employment as this allows the user to apply the template's values and augment this with any specific values.

<h1 id="loketnl-api-workflows">Workflows</h1>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/workflows/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/workflows/{workflowId}`

__Activity name:__ GetWorkflowByWorkflowId

Get the details of a workflow

## Allows the user to transition the workflow.

  }'

`POST /providers/employers/workflows/{workflowId}/transition`

__Activity name:__ TransitionWorkflowByWorkflowId
  

Allows the user to transition the workflow to a different state. 
Use the workflows endpoint and then the `allowedTransitions` element to determine what to submit to this endpoint.

> Body parameter

```json

  "action": "fabf3b25-abf9-4e8c-a8f7-81400d1b0e96",
  "description": "Approve"
}

<h1 id="loketnl-api-declarations">Declarations</h1>

NL: Declaraties/werknemermutaties. Declarations can be created by the employee in Werknemerloket. After that the declarations will be subsequently reviewed and processed in the payrolling process. Please note that this ONLY includes the declarations via Werknemerloket, in general mutations are registered via payrollPeriodData

## Get a list of declarations with attachment

<a id="opIdGetDeclarationsWithAttachmentByEmployerId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/employees/employments/declarations/withattachment \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/{employerId}/employees/employments/declarations/withattachment`

__Activity name :__ GetDeclarationsWithAttachmentByEmployerId

Get a list of all declarationId's of declarations that have an attachment to it. 

The attachment is stored in Qwoater, and thus on the background a call to Qwoater will be performed to check whether an attachment is available for a declaration.

If an attachment is available then a call may be performed to the other endpoint to actually start downloading the attachment for this declaration.

<h1 id="loketnl-api-initialise-payroll-period">Initialise Payroll Period</h1>

NL: Initialiseer periode/ automatische processen activeren. One of the first steps in the payroll process is to initialise (automatische processen) for a given payroll period

## Initialise Payroll Period (automatische processen)

<a id="opIdPostInitialisePayrollPeriodByPayrollAdministrationId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/payrollperiods/initialise \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "payrollPeriod": {
      "periodNumber": 1,
      "year": 2017
    },
    "setAnnualBaseForCalculationsBasedOnFunds": false,
    "setBaseForCalculations": false,
    "setHoursWorked": false,
    "setLeaveHours": false
  }'
```

`POST /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/{payrollAdministrationId}/payrollperiods/initialise`

__Activity name :__ PostInitialisePayrollPeriodByPayrollAdministrationId This is a controller endpoint to perform an action.


In the older Loket GUI this specific action is referred to as 'Automatische processen activeren'. If this action is performed for the chosen payroll period then certain calculations will be performed on the background. The execution depends on the input parameters and the payroll configuration in the given situation.


This action may be performed for all payroll periods that are available for the payroll administration AND that meet one of the following requirements;
* Payroll periods for which an approved payroll run (status = 9) is available
* The very first payroll period in time that does not yet have an approved payroll run(i.e. last payroll period with approved run + 1). Within each year, if available.

In practice, in many instances the second option will be most relevant. Please note that if the action is performed for a year that is not the current active year of payrolling, then the resulting changes may not be fully processed in regards to the full payroll process.


__Metadata :__  No metadata endpoint available for this controller endpoint.

__Defaults :__ Defaults endpoint is available for this controller endpoint.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "payrollPeriod": {
    "periodNumber": 1,
    "year": 2017
  },
  "setAnnualBaseForCalculationsBasedOnFunds": false,
  "setBaseForCalculations": false,
  "setHoursWorked": false,
  "setLeaveHours": false
}
```

<h3 id="initialise-payroll-period-automatische-processen-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payrollAdministrationId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of an administration|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|body|body|object|true|Perform Calculation Payload.|
|» payrollPeriod|body|object(metadata)|false|none|
|» » periodNumber|body|integer(int32)|false|The period (month [1 to 12] , 4 weeks [1 to 13] or week [1 to 53]) of the payroll period.<br>|
|» » year|body|integer(int32)|false|The year of the payroll period<br>|
|» setAnnualBaseForCalculationsBasedOnFunds|body|boolean|false|Jaargrondslag fondsen bepalen. Sets baseForCalculationsBasedOnFunds-related component(s) in the payroll period data based on the configuration of the employment.|
|» setBaseForCalculations|body|boolean|false|Grondslagen activeren. Sets baseForCalculation-related component(s) in the payroll period data based on the configuration of the employment.|
|» setHoursWorked|body|boolean|false|Berekenen uren. Sets hours worked-related component(s) in the payroll period data based on the configuration of the employment.|
|» setLeaveHours|body|boolean|false|Verlofuren op basis van uren bepalen. Sets leave hours-related component(s) in the payroll period data based on the configuration of the employment.|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-initiate-payroll-run">Initiate payroll run</h1>

NL: Start verloningsrun. This endpoint may be used to start running the actual process of a payroll run. (Verlonen)

## Initiate payroll run (verlonen)

<a id="opIdPostInitiatePayrollRunByPayrollAdministrationId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/payrollruns/initiate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "availableForEmployeeDate": "2018-05-08",
    "payrollPeriod": {
      "periodNumber": 1,
      "year": 2017
    },
    "sendEmailToEmployee": true,
    "textPaySlip": "string",
    "textPayment": "string",
    "textTariffPaySlip": "string",
    "initiationParameters": {
      "emailAddressPayrollRunFinished": "info@loket.nl",
      "emailAddressPayrollRunStarted": "info@loket.nl",
      "typeOfInitiation": "regular"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/{payrollAdministrationId}/payrollruns/initiate`

__Activity name :__ PostInitiatePayrollRunByPayrollAdministrationId This is a controller endpoint to perform an action.

In the older Loket GUI this specific action is referred to as respectively 'Verlonen' / 'Verlonen periode zonder personeel' / 'Verlonen voorgaande jaren' . If this action is performed succesfully then the payroll run will be created with status 0 and will be cued for further processing. The further processing depends on the input parameters and the payroll configuration in the given situation. After the initiated run has been picked up and processed by the background process, then the status of the run will be changed accordingly.

This action may be performed for all payroll periods that are *available for the payroll administration* AND that meet one of the following requirements;

If typeOfInitiation = 'regular' (Verlonen);
* The very last payroll period for which an approved payroll run (status = 9) is available. Within the given year of payrolling. (This would functionally be a so-called 'correction' run)
* The very first payroll period in time that does not yet have an approved payroll run (i.e. last payroll period with approved run + 1). Within the given year of payrolling, if available
* The provided year may be a maximum of 7 years in the past (based on current datetime)

If typeOfInitiation = 'withoutEmploymentData' (Verlonen zonder personeel);
* The very first payroll period in time that does not yet have an approved payroll run (i.e. last payroll period with approved run + 1). Within the active year of payrolling
* Please note that if this type is selected then the following fields must ALL be set to null; sendEmailToEmployee, textPaySlip, textTariffPaySlip, textPayment, emailAdressPayrollRunStarted, emailFinishedPayrollRun


In general;
* It is not possible to initiate a new payroll run if there is currently a payroll run with status 0  (to be processed) or 1 (awaiting approval) within the payroll administation.


__Metadata :__  No metadata endpoint available for this controller endpoint.

__Defaults :__ Defaults endpoint is available for this controller endpoint by adding /defaults. Also, an endpoint is available to retrieve initiation values for a specific period.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "availableForEmployeeDate": "2018-05-08",
  "payrollPeriod": {
    "periodNumber": 1,
    "year": 2017
  },
  "sendEmailToEmployee": true,
  "textPaySlip": "string",
  "textPayment": "string",
  "textTariffPaySlip": "string",
  "initiationParameters": {
    "emailAddressPayrollRunFinished": "info@loket.nl",
    "emailAddressPayrollRunStarted": "info@loket.nl",
    "typeOfInitiation": "regular"
  }
}
```

<h1 id="loketnl-api-undo-payroll-run">Undo payroll run</h1>

NL: Verloningsrun verwijderen. In exceptional cases the payroll run could be undone after it already has been approved.

## Undo payroll run (verwijderen loonrun)

<a id="opIdUndoPayrollRunByPayrollRunId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrollruns/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/undo \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/payrollruns/{payrollrunId}/undo`

__Activity name :__ UndoPayrollRunByPayrollRunId This is a controller endpoint to perform an action.

In the older Loket GUI this specific action is referred to as 'Verwijderen loonrun' If this action is performed succesfully then the payroll run will be 'deleted' in the sense that its results will be undone. Please note that situations where an approved payroll run would have to be 'undone' should be generally be avoided. Preferably any mistakes or consistencies should be picked out at an earlier stage in the payroll process.

This action may only be performed succesfully of the following requirements are met;

* The payroll run is the very last payroll run that has been approved within this payroll administration
* It is not possible to undo a  payroll run if there is currently a payroll run with status 0  (to be processed) or 1 (awaiting approval) within the payroll administation.
* Additionally, no related (external) information should still be present for the given payroll run. This will be validated by the endpoint.

__Metadata :__  No metadata endpoint available for this controller endpoint.

__Defaults :__ No defaults endpoint available for this controller endpoint.

<h1 id="loketnl-api-paygrade">Paygrade</h1>

Salarisschaalcel

## Paygrade metadata for concept employee

<a id="opIdGetConceptEmployeePayGradeMetaDataByPayrollAdministrationIdAndPayscaleKeyAndPayGradeKey"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/conceptemployees/metadata/payrollAdministration/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/payScale/0/paygrade/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/conceptemployees/metadata/payrollAdministration/{payrollAdministrationId}/payScale/{payscaleKey}/paygrade/{paygradeKey}`

__Activity name :__ GetConceptEmployeePayGradeMetaDataByPayrollAdministrationIdAndPayscaleKeyAndPayGradeKey

Acquire data on a specific paygrade, this consists of a list of paygrade values and their respective startDates.

If a valid `date` parameter is included in the call, the list will consists of one item that is applicable for that date.


<h3 id="paygrade-metadata-for-concept-employee-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payrollAdministrationId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of an administration|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|payscaleKey|path|integer|true|Key for specific payscale|
|paygradeKey|path|integer|true|Key for specific paygrade|
|date|query|string(date)|false|A valid date (xxxx-xx-xx)|
|filter|query|string|false|Filter the collection|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Order the collection on one or more fields|
|pageNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies which page should be returned|
|pageSize|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies the number of objects per page|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  [
    {
      "startDate": "2018-01-01",
      "value": 1153.1
    }
  ]
]
```

<h3 id="paygrade-metadata-for-concept-employee-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|

<h3 id="paygrade-metadata-for-concept-employee-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[object]]|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>
