## Upload a document to the employment dossier

<a id="opIdPostDocumentByEmploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/documents \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "attribute": "VSP004",
    "category": "Arbeidsovereenkomst",
    "dateOfAlert": "2018-05-08",
    "description": "Copy of id card",
    "year": 2017,
    "filename": "BowlsJohn.pdf",
    "file": "YQ==",
    "sendEmailNotification": true
  }'
```

`POST /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/documents`

__Activity name :__ PostDocumentByEmploymentId

__Metadata:__ Possible options for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired(GET)by adding `/metadata` to the POST URL.

Upload a document within the employee's employment dossier (werknemerdossier). Via Qwoater.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "attribute": "VSP004",
  "category": "Arbeidsovereenkomst",
  "dateOfAlert": "2018-05-08",
  "description": "Copy of id card",
  "year": 2017,
  "filename": "BowlsJohn.pdf",
  "file": "YQ==",
```

## Change the status of a upa pension declaration

<a id="opIdPatchUpaPensionDeclarationByUpaPensionDeclarationId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/payrolladministrations/upapensiondeclarations/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "action": "confirm"
  }'
```

`PATCH /providers/employers/payrolladministrations/upapensiondeclarations/{upaPensionDeclarationId}`

__Activity name :__ PatchUpaPensionDeclarationByUpaPensionDeclarationId

This endpoints changes the status of the Upa pensiondeclaration based on the provided action.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "confirm"
}
```

|upaPensionDeclarationId|path|string|true|Automatically added|
|body|body|object|true|The request body contains the action (cancel / confirm)<br>|
|» action|body|string|true|The action to perform on the upa pensiondeclaration|

|Parameter|Value|

|» action|cancel|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-download-request">Download request</h1>

NL: Werkgever Download Verzoek. An employer user may create a so-called download request. Once this request has been succesfully processed a download (zip file) will be available for this user, containing a wide set of data for the accessible employers. This data may be used for custom reporting or dashboarding etc. Please note this this function is only available for employer users (NOT provider users) and that the download file will contain information related to all employers this specific user has access to. Finally, only the user itself will have access to his/her own download requests.

## List of download requests for an employment

<a id="opIdGetDownloadRequestsByBearerToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/users/downloadrequests \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/users/downloadrequests`

__Note:__ The module (product) has to be activited for all the employers the user has access to. The same holds true for the permissions (rechten) of the users for these employers.

`POST /providers/employers/employees/{employeeId}/employments`

__Activity name :__ PostEmploymentByEmployeeId

Create an additional employment for an already existing employee.

Please note that the creation of an Employment is not RESTful by design.

In Loket, when a new Employee is created it will have to be created including its underlying Employment and its accessory resources. This specific endpoint is relevant in the following scenario: there is already an Employee with at least one Employment, and one wishes to create an additional Employment for that currently existing Employee. When successfully calling this endpoint, an Employment with its accessory resources will be created.

__Metadata :__ 
* Possible options (metadata) for generic fields of the type "metadata" can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the URL.
* Possible options dependent on a specific payrollAdministration can be acquired by adding `/metadata/payrolladministration/{payrollAdministrationId}` to the url.
* Possible options for payGrade can be acquired by adding `metadata/payrolladministration/{payrollAdministrationId}/payscale/{payScaleKey}` to the url.

A `payGrade` has time based values dictating the wage for a given period. These values can be acquired by performing another metadata request by adding `/metadata/payrolladministration/{payrollAdministrationId}/payscale/{payScaleKey}/paygrade/{payGradeKey}` to the url. This endpoint has the optional parameter "date" that may be used to specifying a measure date.

__Defaults :__ Default values for a new object can be acquired by adding `/defaults` to the URL. 

        
Default values that are dependent on the selected payroll administration can be acquired by adding `../providers/employers/employees/employments/defaults/payrolladministration/{payrollAdministrationId}` to the URL.

__NonPayrollAdministrations__ For nonPayrollAdministrations the equivalent metaData-endpoints are also available as described above.  Also, a defaults endpoint is available for the nonPayrollAdministration.  Please note that this requires `../nonpayrolladministrations/{nonPayrollAdministrationId}` in the path.

|» » » key|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» » employmentContractType|body|object(metadata)|false|The type of employment applicable for the employment.|
|» » » key|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» » employmentDurationType|body|object(metadata)|false|A selection of pre defined durations for the employment.|
|» » » key|body|integer(int32)|false|none|

|» » » key|body|integer(int32)|false|none|

|» » isAnonymousEmployee|body|boolean|false|Indicates whether employee is anonymous |

<h1 id="loketnl-api-last-modified-version-numbers">Last modified version numbers</h1>

The version number of an employer or employment may be used to decrease the number of calls in your sync-based integration.

## List of employer last modified version numbers

<a id="opIdGetEmployerLastModifiedVersionNumbersByUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/lastmodifiedversionnumbers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/lastmodifiedversionnumbers`

__Activity name :__ GetEmployerLastModifiedVersionNumbersByUser

**What does the 'last modified' version number reflect**

The sequence number of an employer is a sequential number that reflects whether any changes have occurred in any of its UNDERLYING employments.

More precisely, it reflects the sequence number after the latest change of any database record that relates to an employment within this employer.   What we consider to be 'underlying' employment data is based on a predefined set of tables, and of course given id.  This predefined set of tables can be found [here](../TablesLastModifiedVersionNumber.xlsx)

The scope of this predefined set is to represent 'static' employment data (vaste gegevens), and thus excludes payroll period data (variabele gegevens).

**When to use**

This endpoint is most useful for integrations that regularly synchronize Loket employment data with another system.  As there are no webhooks available, in practice these integrations would need to regularly poll all data to see whether there any changes in the employment data.  The most elementary approach of getting all employment data every time you sync acquires a LOT of calls, in some cases even millions per day.  Even though we can handle quite a lot, this is not always the desired way for both client and server. Hence, this endpoint enables an alternative solution to set up such an integration.

**How to use**

With every update (including additions and deletions) the version number will increase. I.e. the version number will NEVER decrease over time.  (Please note this is not only true within the context of a single employer (or any other entity) but applies to all changes in the database).
Consequently, in practice one would use this endpoint to check if any empLoyer version numbers have increased by applying the filter query parameter to the version field, for example `?filter=version gt 70429274`.

*Recommended usage*

* Perform your regular synchronization of static employment data
* Store the highest version number, for which you have now processed all changes. (You may use the following parameter to do this `?orderBy=-lastModifiedVersionNumber` )
* Next time you want to perform synchronization. Call this endpoint with parameter `?filter=lastModifiedVersionNumber gt {{YourVersionNumber}}`
* Only get employment information for employers that are included in that filtered list. (exclude all other employers as you already know there have been no changes since the last synchronization)


<h3 id="list-of-employer-last-modified-version-numbers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|filter|query|string|false|Filter the collection|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Order the collection on one or more fields|
|pageNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies which page should be returned|
|pageSize|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies the number of objects per page|

## List of employment version numbers

<a id="opIdGetEmploymentLastModifiedVersionNumbersByUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/employees/employments/lastmodifiedversionnumbers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/{employerId}/employees/employments/lastmodifiedversionnumbers`

__Activity name :__ GetEmploymentLastModifiedVersionNumbersByEmployerId

This endpoint is similar to the GetEmployerLastModifiedVersionNumbersByUser endpoint described above. Please check out that description for required context.

In addition to the version on employer level, this endpoint allows you to check if this employment has any changes since your last synchronization. Consequently, this endpoint may be used to further decrease the amount of required calls when performing a synchronization.

As can be seen in the set of 'underlying' tables, also changes in Employee information corresponding to the Employment is reflected in the version number.

**How to use**

*Recommended usage*
* Perform all recommended steps in the description of the employer version number endpoint
* Use the exact SAME filter parameter to this endpoint. The resulting list will contain only the employment for which changes have occured since your last synchronization.

__Activity name:__ GetExternalTenantsByProviderId

An external tenant may be registered for a Loket user, and may be used to login to Loket using Azure Active Directory. 


<h3 id="get-available-external-tenants-provider-scope-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|providerId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of a provider|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|

<h1 id="loketnl-api-external-tenant-employer-user">External tenant employer user</h1>

External tenants may be used to login to Loket.nl via Azure Active Directory. In order to do that a user must be configured in such a way that it is allowed to a certain external tenant to log in. This resource contains the link between an **employer** user and an allowed external tenant (for that user)

## Configured external tenant for an employer user

<a id="opIdGetConfiguredExternalTenantByEmployerUserId"></a>

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/configuredexternaltenant \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

## Add an external tenant for an employer user

<a id="opIdPatchConfiguredExternalTenantByEmployerUserId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/configuredexternaltenant \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "externalTenant": {
      "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
    },
    "externalUser": {
      "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /providers/employers/users/{employerUserId}/configuredexternaltenant`

__Activity name :__ PatchConfiguredExternalTenantByEmployerUserId

__Metadata :__  N/A.

__Defaults :__ N/A.

Modify an external tenant to the list of an configured external tenants for an employer user.
An configured external tenant may be removed by sending a request body with both an empty externalTenant object and an empty externalUser object.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "externalTenant": {
    "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
  },
  "externalUser": {
    "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="add-an-external-tenant-for-an-employer-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|employerUserId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of a employer user|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|

|» » id|body|string(uuid)|false|The unique identifier of an Azure AD user. The id of an user can be found in in Azure AD application. `PATCH /providers/users/{providerUserId}/configuredexternaltenant`

__Activity name :__ PatchConfiguredExternalTenantByProviderUserId

__Metadata :__  N/A.

__Defaults :__ N/A.

Modify an external tenant to the list of an configured external tenants for an employer user.
An configured external tenant may be removed by sending a request body with both an empty externalTenant object and an empty externalUser object.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "externalTenant": {
    "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
  },
  "externalUser": {
    "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
  }
}
```

`GET /providers/employers/{employerId}/emailtemplates`

__Activity name :__ GetEmailTemplatesByEmployerId

## List of wage proposals for the employments of an employer

<a id="opIdGetWageProposalsByEmployerId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/employees/employments/WageProposals \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/employers/{employerId}/employees/employments/WageProposals`

__Activity name :__ GetWageProposalsByEmployerId

Returns a list of wage proposals for the employments of the employer.
A wage proposal is created when an employment reaches the criteria set for the next tier of wage. 
E.G the minimum wage is linked to the age of a person so a wage proposal is created 60 days befor the birthday of an employment linked to the minimum wage and configured for wage proposals.
Via this functionality the created wage proposal can be approved or rejected resulting in either a new wage record updated to reflect the correct wage or in case of a rejection the employment is disabled for wage proposals.


<h3 id="list-of-wage-proposals-for-the-employments-of-an-employer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|employerId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the employer|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|filter|query|string|false|Filter the collection|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Order the collection on one or more fields|
|pageNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies which page should be returned|
|pageSize|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies the number of objects per page|

<a id="opIdPostWageProjectionByEmploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/wageprojection \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "calculateUsingNextYearsValues": true,
    "deviations": {
      "hoursPerWeek": 37.5,
      "percentageChange": 25,
      "startDate": "1995-05-21"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/wageprojection`

__Activity name :__ PostWageProjectionByEmploymentId

This endpoint can only be used for employments that are already known in the loket.nl system.

__Metadata :__  No metadata endpoint available for this controller endpoint.

__Defaults :__ No defaults endpoint available for this controller endpoint.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "calculateUsingNextYearsValues": true,
  "deviations": {
    "hoursPerWeek": 37.5,
    "percentageChange": 25,
    "startDate": "1995-05-21"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="perform-a-wage-projection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|employmentId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the employment|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» calculateUsingNextYearsValues|body|boolean \| null|false|If set to true the wage projection will use the (government) salary values of the next payroll year to calculate the wages. This gives some insight in what the employments wages will do next year based on the government's tax plans."|
|» deviations|body|object \| null|false|This endpoint can only be used for employments that are already known in the loket.nl system. If however you want to perform a calculation with different parameters then that are known in the loket system they can be set here|
|» » hoursPerWeek|body|number \| null|false|The hours per week used in wage calculations.|
|» » percentageChange|body|number \| null|false|The percentage change used in wage calculations.|
|» » startDate|body|string(date)|false|The start date for the information in the record.|

## Perform a wage projection based on a default CLA configuration

<a id="opIdPostWageprojectionBasedOnDefaultClaConfigurationByEmploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/employees/employments/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/wageprojection/basedOnDefaultClaConfiguration \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "additionalPayrollPeriod": {
      "percentage": 8,
      "resultPayrollComponent": {
        "key": 83
      }
    },
    "applyPayrollTaxDeduction": false,
    "calculateUsingNextYearsValues": true,
    "companyCar": {
      "fiscalAddition": 345.87,
      "fiscalAdditionPeriod": "Year"
    },
    "dateOfBirth": "1995-05-21",
    "deductions": {
      "gross": 50.87,
      "net": 50.87
    },
    "deviations": {
      "grossWagePercentageChange": 25,
      "hoursPerWeek": 37.5
    },
    "grossWage": 3500,
    "holidayAllowance": {
      "percentage": 8,
      "resultPayrollComponent": {
        "key": 82
      }
    },
    "hoursPerWeek": 24.5,
    "payments": {
      "gross": 50.87,
      "net": 50.87
    }
  }'
```

`POST /providers/employers/employees/employments/{employmentId}/wageprojection/basedOnDefaultClaConfiguration`

__Activity name :__ PostWageprojectionBasedOnDefaultClaConfigurationByEmploymentId

This endpoint can be used to calculate a wage projection based on a default collective labor agreement (CLA) configuration.  The input fields allow for certain customizations.

__Metadata :__  No metadata endpoint available for this controller endpoint.

__Defaults :__ No defaults endpoint available for this controller endpoint.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "additionalPayrollPeriod": {
    "percentage": 8,
    "resultPayrollComponent": {
      "key": 83
    }
  },
  "applyPayrollTaxDeduction": false,
  "calculateUsingNextYearsValues": true,
  "companyCar": {
    "fiscalAddition": 345.87,
    "fiscalAdditionPeriod": "Year"
  },
  "dateOfBirth": "1995-05-21",
  "deductions": {
    "gross": 50.87,
    "net": 50.87
  },
  "deviations": {
    "grossWagePercentageChange": 25,
    "hoursPerWeek": 37.5
  },
  "grossWage": 3500,
  "holidayAllowance": {
    "percentage": 8,
    "resultPayrollComponent": {
      "key": 82
    }
  },
  "hoursPerWeek": 24.5,
  "payments": {
    "gross": 50.87,
    "net": 50.87
  }
}
```

<h3 id="perform-a-wage-projection-based-on-a-default-cla-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|employmentId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of the employment|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» additionalPayrollPeriod|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » percentage|body|number|false|The percentage for the additional payroll period wage the employment receives (13e maand / extra periode loon / winstuitkering)|
|» » resultPayrollComponent|body|object(metadata)|false|A payroll component. These components are the core of the wage calculation software.<br><br>`payrollComponents` is a metadata field within the payroll administration, loonmodel and cao context. Possible values can be managed by the user.|
|» » » key|body|integer(int32)|false|The number for the payroll component. This number has meaning to payroll professionals using Loket.nl who often know many of them by heart.<br>|
|» applyPayrollTaxDeduction|body|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether payroll tax deduction is to be applied (loonheffingskorting)|
|» calculateUsingNextYearsValues|body|boolean \| null|false|If set to true the wage projection will use the (government) salary values of the next payroll year to calculate the wages. This gives some insight in what the employments wages will do next year based on the government's tax plans."|
|» companyCar|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » fiscalAddition|body|number|false|The fiscal addition to the wage for the given `fiscalAdditionPeriod` for the lease/company car<br>|
|» » fiscalAdditionPeriod|body|string|false|Periodicity of the `fiscalAddition`|
|» dateOfBirth|body|string(date)|false|The date of birth<br>|
|» deductions|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » gross|body|number \| null|false|The gross deduction from the wage<br>|
|» » net|body|number \| null|false|The net deduction from the wage<br>|
|» deviations|body|object \| null|false|Deviations allow the user to calculate the difference between the current wage and the wage after certain deviations.<br>If no deviations are required set the object to NULL|
|» » grossWagePercentageChange|body|number \| null|false|The percentage change used in wage calculations.|
|» » hoursPerWeek|body|number \| null|false|The hours per week used in wage calculations.|
|» grossWage|body|number(double)|false|The grosswage per payroll period|
|» holidayAllowance|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » percentage|body|number|false|The percentage for the holiday bonus (vakantiegeld)|
|» » resultPayrollComponent|body|object(metadata)|false|none|
|» » » key|body|integer(int32)|false|The number for the payroll component. This number has meaning to payroll professionals using Loket.nl who often know many of them by heart.<br>|
|» hoursPerWeek|body|number(double)|false|The hours per week te be used in the wage calculation. <br><br>Please note that currently this endpoint will always calculate as if the hours provided are full time hours.|
|» payments|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » gross|body|number \| null|false|The gross payment added to the wage<br>|
|» » net|body|number \| null|false|The net payment added to the wage<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » fiscalAdditionPeriod|Year|
|» » fiscalAdditionPeriod|payrollPeriod|

```bash
curl https://example.com/wageprojection/cladata/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

__Activity name :__ GetClaDataForWageProjectionByCollectiveLaborAgreementId

__Activity name :__ GetEmploymentPayrollDataAuditTrailByPayrollAdministrationId

Returns the changes that were made in the payroll data for the employments. 

This includes resources such as (allmost all payroll related resources except `payroll period data` which has its own audit trail download):
- Wage
- Working hours
- Bennefits and deductions
- Employment
- Fiscal properties
- Organizational entity

<h3 id="download-the-audit-trail-for-the-employment-payroll-data-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|payrollAdministrationId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of an administration|
|startDate|query|string|true|The start date|
|endDate|query|string|true|The end date|

## Manage the employer user notification settings

<a id="opIdPatchEmployerUserNotificationSettingsByUserId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/notificationsettings \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "notificationSet": {
      "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
    },
    "notifications": [
      {
        "createNumberOfDaysBeforeEvent": 30,
        "isEnabled": true,
        "notificationType": {
          "key": 3
        },
        "receiveDepartmentSignalsOnly": false,
        "sendMailWhenNotificationIsCreated": false
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PATCH /providers/employers/users/{userId}/notificationsettings`

__Activity name :__ PatchEmployerUserNotificationSettingsByUserId

Manage the employer user notifications and `notificationSet`.

__Note:__ Currently the `notificationSet` doesnt do anything in regard to which notifications are enabled or disabled.  It only functions as a guide to the GUI to visualize and save the notifications linked to the `notificationSet`

Only the changes supplied are processed existing records not supplied in the request body will be left unchanged.  e.g. If three notifications are enabled for the user and a patch is performed with in the body one new notification with the `isEnabled` = true. The result will be that the user has 4 enabled notifications.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "notificationSet": {
    "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
  },
  "notifications": [
    {
      "createNumberOfDaysBeforeEvent": 30,
      "isEnabled": true,
      "notificationType": {
        "key": 3
      },
      "receiveDepartmentSignalsOnly": false,
      "sendMailWhenNotificationIsCreated": false
    }
  ]
}
```

|body|body|object|true|none|
|» notificationSet|body|object(metadata)|false|none|
|» » id|body|string(uuid)|false|The unique identifier of an object (GUID/UUID)<br>|

|» » isEnabled|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable a notification for a user|
|» » notificationType|body|object(metadata) \| null|false|The notification set|
|» » » key|body|integer(int32)|false|none|
|» » receiveDepartmentSignalsOnly|body|boolean|false|Only receive notification for your departments.<br>Not relevant if the user is not a department manager.|

## Manage the employer user authorizations

<a id="opIdPatchEmployerUserAuthorizationsByUserId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/employers/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/authorizations \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json;version=2018-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "authorizationSet": {
      "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
    },
    "authorizations": [
      {
        "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab",
        "isEnabled": true
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PATCH /providers/employers/{employerId}/users/{userId}/authorizations`

__Activity name :__ PatchEmployerUserAuthorizationsByUserId

Manage the employer user authorizations and `authorizationSet`.


Only the changes supplied are processed existing records not supplied in the request body will be left unchanged.  e.g. If three authorizations are enabled for the user and a patch is performed with in the body one new authorization with the `isEnabled` = true. The result will be that the user has 4 enabled authorizations.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "authorizationSet": {
    "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab"
  },
  "authorizations": [
    {
      "id": "b14acd0d-75d7-4fc8-8b22-4a3924585cab",
      "isEnabled": true
    }
  ]
}
```

<h1 id="loketnl-api-emailtemplates">Emailtemplates</h1>

## List email templates for an provider

<a id="opIdGetEmailTemplatesByProviderId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/providers/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/emailtemplates \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/{providerId}/emailtemplates`

__Activity name :__ GetEmailTemplatesByProviderId

Get a list of the email templates for an provider.

__Note:__ Email templates can be defined on employer, provider and loket level. This endpoint returns for each emailtype the email template which is currently in use for the provider.

<h1 id="loketnl-api-payroll-process-status">Payroll process status</h1>

## Payroll status for each administration.

<a id="opIdGetPayrollProcessStatusByProviderId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/providers/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/payrollprocessstatus?payrollPeriodId=202201' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /providers/{providerId}/payrollprocessstatus`

__Activity name :__ GetPayrollProcessStatusByProviderId

__Metadata :__  Possible options for fields of the type 'metadata' can be acquired (GET) by adding `/metadata` to the POST URL.

__Defaults :__ The default value for payrollPeriod.payrollPeriodId can be acquired by adding `/defaults' to the POST URL. 

Returns an array of objects. Each object contains information about the payroll administration and the payroll processes status.


<h3 id="payroll-status-for-each-administration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|providerId|path|string(uuid)|true|The unique identifier of a provider|
|Authorization|header|string|true|A valid Bearer token for authorizing the request.|
|Accept|header|string|true|The accept header is used to influence what type of output is returned and in most cases the version of the output|
|payrollPeriodId|query|integer(int32)|true|The unique identifier of the payroll period to return|
|filter|query|string|false|Filter the collection|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Order the collection on one or more fields|
|pageNumber|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies which page should be returned|
|pageSize|query|integer(int32)|false|Specifies the number of objects per page|
